parsed.note_claim: AI videos of emotional animal stories are common on social media and can mislead viewers.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Skimming through social media, AI-generated images and videos of wildlife are ubiquitous. Technology is advancing rapidly, making it more challenging to identify a fake from the real thing.
parsed.reason: The article directly substantiates that AI-generated animal videos are common on social media and can mislead people, though it does not address the specific seal video.
